mainGame.vectorTable.fx.label: Effect
mainGame.vectorTable.fx.means.up: Toward ease: more push or less drag; the trip leans toward ease and the story runs smoother.
mainGame.vectorTable.fx.means.down: Toward strain: more drag or less push; the trip leans toward strain and the story meets more resistance.
mainGame.vectorTable.fx.means.social: Relations: ties between people move forward more easily.
mainGame.vectorTable.fx.means.socialLess: Fewer relations: ties between people move forward less easily.
mainGame.vectorTable.fx.means.chance: Chances: good turns and openings come up more easily.
mainGame.vectorTable.fx.means.chanceLess: Fewer chances: good turns and openings come up less easily.
mainGame.vectorTable.fx.means.route: Route: turns the shuttle round, or makes it walk more or fewer steps.
mainGame.vectorTable.fx.means.store: Stores: keeps some force aside and lets it all out later, half again on top.
mainGame.vectorTable.fx.means.push: Push: moves the trip toward ease.
mainGame.vectorTable.fx.means.drag: Drag: pulls the trip toward strain; less drag means fewer setbacks.
mainGame.vectorTable.fx.means.steps: Steps: how many cells the shuttle walks this trip.
mainGame.vectorTable.fx.means.turn: Turn: the shuttle turns round and walks back.
mainGame.vectorTable.fx.means.release: Release: puts everything stored back into the trip, half again on top.
mainGame.vectorTable.fx.means.convert: Convert: turns one force into another.
mainGame.vectorTable.fx.means.relay: Relay: acts on the next card that acts, not on the shuttle itself.
mainGame.vectorTable.fx.means.echo: Again: the next card that acts does it once more.
mainGame.vectorTable.fx.means.level: Level: how far this card has grown; kept in the save.
mainGame.vectorTable.fx.means.depart: At departure: the moment the shuttle sets out from 01, before its first step.
mainGame.vectorTable.fx.strength.1: One stroke: over a trip, about what a plain card with push +1 each time gives.
mainGame.vectorTable.fx.strength.2: Two strokes: over a trip, two to three times that plain card.
mainGame.vectorTable.fx.strength.3: Three strokes: over a trip, three and a half times that plain card or more.
mainGame.vectorTable.fx.perActTip: The number is what it brings each time it acts, averaged over the engine's test trips on both boards.
